meta.name: outreach-manager
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "write influencer outreach", "follow up with a creator", "pitch a journalist, hunter, or launch partner", or "negotiate partnership terms"; produces personalized pitches, multi-touch follow-up sequences, negotiation scripts with objection handling, and a status pipeline tracker — the shared outreach mechanics engine for creator, media/analyst, launch-partner, and social-selling / advocate-recruitment targets. Not for finalizing signed agreements — use contract-helper; not for media-list tiering, embargo terms, or press-release structure — use press-media-relations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写个性化推广邀约并跟进谈判
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化联系创作者、记者或合作伙伴并推进合作。
copy.tagline_en: Write personalized outreach pitches and follow up with negotiation scripts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically contact creators, journalists, or partners and advance partnerships.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能帮你写个性化的推广私信、设计多轮跟进流程、准备谈判话术，并记录每个联系人的沟通状态。
howto.when: 当你要求“写推广私信”、“跟进某个创作者”、“谈判合作条件”或“追踪推广进度”时触发。

say.text: 帮我对 @sustainablesarah 写一条推广私信，推广有机护肤品。
say.note: Claude 会生成个性化消息和跟进计划。

say.text: 列出我当前推广管线的状态，包括已联系和已确认的创作者。
say.note: Claude 会生成管线追踪表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write personalized outreach messages, design multi-touch follow-up sequences, prepare negotiation scripts, and track the status of each contact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "write influencer outreach", "follow up with a creator", "negotiate partnership terms", or "track outreach pipeline".

say_en.text: Write an outreach message to @sustainablesarah for our organic skincare launch.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a personalized pitch and follow-up plan.

say_en.text: Help me negotiate with @techreviewer who is asking for $5000 when our budget is $3000.
say_en.note: Claude will provide negotiation strategies and scripts.

say_en.text: Show me the current status of my outreach pipeline, including contacted and confirmed creators.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a pipeline tracker.
